members.name: tvg_scene_new
description: This function allocates and returns a new Scene instance. To properly destroy the Scene object, use tvg_paint_rel().

members.name: tvg_scene_add
members.brief: Adds a paint object to the scene.
description: Appends the specified paint object to the given scene. Only paint objects added to the scene are considered rendering targets.

params.name: scene
params.description: A handle to the scene object. This parameter must not be `nullptr`.

params.name: paint
params.description: A handle to the paint object to be added to the scene. This parameter must not be `nullptr`.

notes: Ownership of the `paint` object is transferred to the canvas upon successful addition. To retain ownership, call tvg_paint_ref() before adding it to the scene.
The rendering order of paint objects follows their order in the root scene. If layering is required, ensure the paints are added in the desired order.

members.name: tvg_scene_insert
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_scene_insert(Tvg_Paint scene, Tvg_Paint target, Tvg_Paint at)
members.brief: Inserts a paint object into the scene.
description: Inserts the specified paint object into the scene immediately before the given paint object `at`. The `at` parameter must reference an existing paint object already added to the scene.

params.name: scene
params.description: A handle to the scene object. This parameter must not be `nullptr`.

params.name: target
params.description: A handle to the paint object to be inserted into the scene. This parameter must not be `nullptr`.

params.name: at
params.description: A handle to an existing paint object in the scene before which `target` will be inserted. This parameter must not be `nullptr`.

notes: Ownership of the `target` object is transferred to the scene upon successful addition. To retain ownership, call tvg_paint_ref() before adding it to the scene.
The rendering order of paint objects follows their order in the root scene. If layering is required, ensure the paints are added in the desired order.

members.name: tvg_scene_remove
members.brief: Removes a paint object from the scene.
description: This function removes a specified paint object from the scene. If no paint object is specified (i.e., the default `nullptr` is used), the function performs to clear all paints from the scene.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint object to be removed from the scene. If `nullptr`, remove all the paints from the scene.

members.name: tvg_scene_clear_effects
members.brief: Clears all previously applied scene effects.
description: This function clears all effects that have been applied to the scene, restoring it to its original state without any post-processing.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

members.name: tvg_scene_add_effect_gaussian_blur
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_scene_add_effect_gaussian_blur(Tvg_Paint scene, double sigma, int direction, int border, int quality)
members.brief: Adds a Gaussian blur effect to the scene.
description: This function adds a Gaussian blur filter to the scene as a post-processing effect. The blur can be applied in different directions with configurable border handling and quality settings.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

params.name: sigma
params.description: The blur radius (sigma) value. Must be greater than 0.

params.name: direction
params.description: Blur direction: 0 = both directions, 1 = horizontal only, 2 = vertical only.

params.name: border
params.description: Border handling method: 0 = duplicate, 1 = wrap.

params.name: quality
params.description: Blur quality level [0 - 100].

members.name: tvg_scene_add_effect_drop_shadow
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_scene_add_effect_drop_shadow(Tvg_Paint scene, int r, int g, int b, int a, double angle, double distance, double sigma, int quality)
members.brief: Adds a drop shadow effect to the scene.
description: This function adds a drop shadow with a Gaussian blur to the scene. The shadow can be customized using color, opacity, angle, distance, blur radius (sigma), and quality parameters.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

params.name: r
params.description: Red channel value of the shadow color [0 - 255].

params.name: g
params.description: Green channel value of the shadow color [0 - 255].

params.name: b
params.description: Blue channel value of the shadow color [0 - 255].

params.name: a
params.description: Alpha (opacity) channel value of the shadow [0 - 255].

params.name: angle
params.description: Shadow direction in degrees [0 - 360].

params.name: distance
params.description: Distance of the shadow from the original object.

params.name: sigma
params.description: Gaussian blur sigma value for the shadow. Must be > 0.

params.name: quality
params.description: Blur quality level [0 - 100].

members.name: tvg_scene_add_effect_fill
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_scene_add_effect_fill(Tvg_Paint scene, int r, int g, int b, int a)
members.brief: Adds a fill color effect to the scene.
description: This function overrides the scene's content colors with the specified fill color.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

params.name: r
params.description: Red color channel value [0 - 255].

params.name: g
params.description: Green color channel value [0 - 255].

params.name: b
params.description: Blue color channel value [0 - 255].

params.name: a
params.description: Alpha (opacity) channel value [0 - 255].

members.name: tvg_scene_add_effect_tint
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_scene_add_effect_tint(Tvg_Paint scene, int black_r, int black_g, int black_b, int white_r, int white_g, int white_b, double intensity)
members.brief: Adds a tint effect to the scene.
description: This function tints the current scene using specified black and white color values, modulated by a given intensity.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

params.name: black_r
params.description: Red component of the black color [0 - 255].

params.name: black_g
params.description: Green component of the black color [0 - 255].

params.name: black_b
params.description: Blue component of the black color [0 - 255].

params.name: white_r
params.description: Red component of the white color [0 - 255].

params.name: white_g
params.description: Green component of the white color [0 - 255].

params.name: white_b
params.description: Blue component of the white color [0 - 255].

params.name: intensity
params.description: Tint intensity value [0 - 100].

members.name: tvg_scene_add_effect_tritone
members.signature: Tvg_Result tvg_scene_add_effect_tritone(Tvg_Paint scene, int shadow_r, int shadow_g, int shadow_b, int midtone_r, int midtone_g, int midtone_b, int highlight_r, int highlight_g, int highlight_b, int blend)
members.brief: Adds a tritone color effect to the scene.
description: This function adds a tritone color effect to the given scene using three sets of RGB values representing shadow, midtone, and highlight colors.

params.name: scene
params.description: The scene object.

params.name: shadow_r
params.description: Red component of the shadow color [0 - 255].

params.name: shadow_g
params.description: Green component of the shadow color [0 - 255].

params.name: shadow_b
params.description: Blue component of the shadow color [0 - 255].

params.name: midtone_r
params.description: Red component of the midtone color [0 - 255].

params.name: midtone_g
params.description: Green component of the midtone color [0 - 255].

params.name: midtone_b
params.description: Blue component of the midtone color [0 - 255].

params.name: highlight_r
params.description: Red component of the highlight color [0 - 255].

params.name: highlight_g
params.description: Green component of the highlight color [0 - 255].

params.name: highlight_b
params.description: Blue component of the highlight color [0 - 255].

params.name: blend
params.description: A blending factor that determines the mix between the original color and the tritone colors [0 - 255].
